{{Quote|Where's Eerena? You said you would bring her back!''"<br />"''I found her. I'm sorry. There was nothing I could do.|A Makeb citizen and a Republic scout|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Eerena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], prior to the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[InterStellar Regulators]] before she could be evacuated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.
